build_flux_kontext_pipeline: build a Flux Kontext modular pipeline using FluxKontextAutoBlocks for image-to-image and text2image generation
create_core_denoise_step: create a FluxKontextCoreDenoiseStep that performs denoising for text-to-image and image-conditioned tasks
create_vae_encoder_step: create a FluxKontextAutoVaeEncoderStep that encodes image inputs into latent representations for image-conditioned tasks
create_before_denoise_step: create a FluxKontextAutoBeforeDenoiseStep that prepares inputs for the denoising step for text2image and image-conditioned tasks
create_input_step: create a FluxKontextInputStep that standardizes inputs with consistent batch size and patchified image latents for denoising
